title: Session 6 · Complete every part · Independent application
description: Ten short typed responses practicing complete instructions using supplied everyday information.

definition.title: Session 6 · Complete every part · Independent application
definition.instructions: Read each source and follow its request. Choose your own way to check your response. All information is supplied. Type only the requested words or code in the requested order, separated by spaces. Capitalization does not matter. Example format: green circle. Take a comfortable pace. You may go back to check answers before submitting.

questions.prompt: CARD: Material = cotton. Color = orange. Texture = smooth. Write the MATERIAL, then the TEXTURE. Use only those two words.
questions.explanation: The requested parts in order are cotton smooth. Review an equivalent response manually if formatting affected its score.

questions.prompt: LIST: tennis — racket; soccer — ball; skating — skates. Write the SPORT that uses a racket, then its EQUIPMENT. Use only those two words.
